relationship_decisions.finding: All three exact covers say ANNEX to an unidentified Commission communication and retain placeholder reference text. The official release pages describe one draft work distributed in three sections but do not provide a separately issued parent communication.
relationship_decisions.root_decision_if_scope_changes: A conceptual composite parent could be added only if the project formally decides that the official landing-page representation of the whole three-section work is sufficient parent identity despite no separately issued parent artifact. Under the current attachment-lineage contract, no parent should be invented.
